sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:10

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:10:1
items.html:
Some of them were sweetened and some of them were not sweetened, etc., and a part of each and every one of them was not sweetened and remained below: As above, that it is one Partzuf of Adam, which has shells opposite it from its head to its feet, that is, opposite all the five Partzufim of ZON of Atzilut. And these five Partzufim, which were sorted and became the world of Atzilut, each and every one of them left parts of itself that were not yet sorted, but are destined to be sorted through the raising of MAN from the work of the righteous during the six thousand years of the world of correction.
And know that these remainders of the aforementioned Partzufim of Atzilut, which remained unsorted, are the secret of all the good reward prepared for the righteous by force of the creation of the world with ten utterances, namely the ten vessels of Atzilut from the side of the joining of mercy with judgment, as above; for through this the conduct of reward and punishment came about in the world. And it is by force of the two states of ZON, Katnut and Gadlut: when good deeds are performed, MAN is raised to ZON, and through this it attains Gadlut and GAR, and mercy is revealed; and when evil deeds are performed, they thereby cause ZON to return to the state of Katnut, and a conduct of judgment is revealed in the world. And so it is for each and every individual with respect to his own soul.
Indeed you must understand here that there is no absence in spirituality, and all the more so in Atzilut, where “He, His vessels and His life-force are one in them.” And as for the matter of the Mochin of Gadlut and of Katnut that come and go in ZA of Atzilut because of the deeds of the lower ones, this does not mean that at the time when the Mochin of Katnut come, the preceding Mochin of Gadlut are absent and depart whatsoever. Rather, there is only an addition here, for the preceding Mochin of Gadlut that were drawn through the work of the righteous remain thus for eternity, without any change whatsoever through the evil deeds of the wicked. Rather, the wicked caused new Mochin of Katnut and of judgment to be made, added upon the preceding Mochin; yet the conduct of the world is always by the Mochin that were added last. Thus the chain of time that is found for us in this world, from the side of what was and what is, is drawn to us from the upper ones by the force of internality and externality: what was is drawn from internality, and what is in the present is drawn to us from externality. And the externality is always revealed to us in this world, while the internality is concealed from us and does not serve us at all, but is destined to be revealed to us in the future, at the end of correction.
And this is the secret of “the righteous have no rest, neither in this world nor in the world to come.” And the meaning is not the world to come after their passing, for “among the dead one is free,” as is known. Rather, there are righteous ones who are rewarded with the lights of the world to come in their lifetime, and our sages inform us that even those great righteous ones who have already been rewarded with the world to come in their lifetime still have no rest, but must labour in the holy work and always come in the posterior that precedes the anterior, in order to raise MAN for new and higher Mochin. And this is because there are sortings also in the Partzufim of the GAR of ZA, which are above the lights of the world to come. And this is the secret that the Partzufim of the souls are destined to clothe as far as the level of AK of Assiya, when the levels of the five Partzufim of AK will be equal, as is known. And it will be explained in its place.
And the matter of this clothing, that the souls are rewarded with clothing the upper Partzufim, means the good reward stored up for the righteous in the future. For all the Mochin drawn through the raising of MAN that they raise by force of the good deeds they perform — although afterwards they come in the posterior and once more cause Katnut in ZON — it has been explained that the preceding Mochin of Gadlut are not absent whatsoever, but come in the secret of the internality, as above. Therefore they have a way to draw new Mochin every time, while the first Mochin come to them in internality, so that each time they draw higher Mochin, as above. And all these Mochin that were drawn to the upper Partzufim through the MAN that they raised — all of these belong to their portion. And although in the present they enjoy only those Mochin that they drew last, still the preceding Mochin too remained for eternity, only they do not serve them in the present, as above, so that they may add strength and go from strength to strength; and in the future they will attain all these Mochin that were drawn through them, all at once.
And this is the secret of what our sages said: “The Creator is destined to bequeath to each and every righteous one 310 worlds, as it is said, ‘That I may cause those that love Me to inherit Yesh, and that I may fill their treasuries.’” (End of Tractate Uktzin) Namely the Mochin that they drew in the upper worlds, which are their portion in the future, as explained.
